name: LinearAlgebraGame.norm_pos_of_nonzero
content:
`norm_pos_of_nonzero` is a helper proof that if `v ≠ 0`, then `0 < ‖v‖`. The syntax is
`norm_pos_of_nonzero v v_zero`.
